stats.notes: No Common Data Set was found on cune.edu (searched 2026-10-26), so these are figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data, for the fall 2023 entering class. College Navigator's newer fall 2024 figures: 1,583 applicants, 86% admitted, 25% of admitted enrolled (no admit count printed, so none is computed). Counts are institution-wide first-time students; IPEDS gives no international split or GPA data. Test-score percentiles rest on tiny groups (5 SAT and 18 ACT submitters in 2023). Undergraduate enrollment 3,000 (College Navigator fall 2024) is institution-wide and includes online students; the Seward campus itself has about 1,200 students per the international page. Student-to-faculty ratio 14:1.
